thread:
anya: Heads-up — I want to open a small edge-segment canary for model v3.2-quant on Monday at 09:00 UTC. Targeting 3% traffic split across SEA + EU edge segments for 2h. Quick sanity check before I flip the flag? :eyes:
kevin: What gate signals should we watch first? latency or safety/regressions?
anya: Primary: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, output-entropy drift vs baseline. Secondary: token-cost delta and a small eval set for hallucination checks. If any one of the primary signals spikes > alert thresholds, we abort.
sam: Can you paste the exact flag config you plan to apply? Makes it easier for infra to validate the rollout mapping.
anya: Sure — config I'll push to flag service (also running a dry-run locally):
```yaml
feature_flag: canary.edge_segment.v3_2_quant
model: rwd/v3.2-quant
percent: 3
duration_minutes: 120
regions:
  - eu-west-2: 2
  - ap-southeast-1: 1
guards:
  - latency_p95_threshold_ms: 350
  - error_rate_threshold_pct: 0.5
  - drift_threshold: 0.08
rollout_checks:
  - telemetry: [latency_p50, latency_p95, error_rate]
  - eval: [smoke_prompt_set_v3_regression]
```
mike: We usually run a preflight traffic shadow for 30m on the same segments. Do you want to do that first?
anya: Yes — good call. I'll kick a 30m shadow run at 08:30 UTC to collect KV cache/latency sampling, then enable live 3% at 09:00 if shadows look normal.
kevin: Who's on-call for cutoff? If thresholds hit, who should deploy the rollback?
anya: If deploy-bot fires the auto-abort, infra oncall (mike) gets paged. Manual abort goes to me or kevin. I'll add escalation notes in the rollout doc.
deploy-bot: [automated] feature-flag draft created: canary.edge_segment.v3_2_quant (ID ff_2026_1768888123) — staging preview available at https://flags.redwood/internal/ff_2026_1768888123
sam: One more ask: please include a tiny sample of new-model outputs for the smoke prompt set in the thread once shadow completes (3 examples). Helps product & QA eyeball style drift quickly.
anya: Will do. I'll post payload + 3 outputs after 08:30 shadow run. Planning notes in the rollout doc: /docs/rollouts/edge-seg-v3_2_quant (WIP).
mike: I'll validate routing map and confirm LB sticky session behavior for the edge segments. If anything looks off I'll notify here before 09:00. :thumbsup:
anya: Thanks — flipping to dry-run in 5m. Ping me if you want to sit in the quick review.
kevin: acked. I'll monitor p95 and error_rate dashboards (link: https://dashboards.redwood/telemetry/canary/ff_2026_1768888123).
anya: (after shadow) Shadow looked clean — latency delta +3ms, error_rate stable. Posting sample outputs now.
anya: sample1: "User: summarize quarterly plan
Model: TL;DR: focus on infra, observability, and cost optimizations..."
anya: sample2: "User: legal disclaimer on data handling
Model: We comply with customer KMS and never persist PII in training..."
anya: sample3: "User: developer onboarding checklist
Model: Add SDK quickstart, example prompts, and infra runbook..."
mike: Those samples look fine. I'm green for live 3% ramp at 09:00.
deploy-bot: [action] feature-flag applied: canary.edge_segment.v3_2_quant -> live (3%) regions={eu-west-2:2,ap-southeast-1:1} by anya at 09:00 UTC
kevin: Monitoring. If I see any p95 blowup > 2x baseline or error_rate > 0.5% I'll trigger cutoff.
anya: Thanks all — will call a check-in at +30m and +90m. If anyone spots weird outputs before then, drop them here and tag me. :rocket:
